opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. Only one application at a time; must wait a year after a previous decision.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget (operating/core costs), 10-20% of capital costs (with local community capital projects capped at £30,000), and 10-20% of project costs.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs: organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs: total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1 million). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) should apply for a regular grant instead.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round (no deadlines), reviewed on a rolling basis; if taken forward, invited to submit a full proposal for consideration at a board meeting.
